subject: Publisher onboarding: offer deployment runbook + operator access coordination
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: partners@acmecloud.com, susan.hill@contoso.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Publisher onboarding: offer deployment runbook + operator access coordination

Hi Susan / ACME team —

Thanks for agreeing to an operator-mode onboarding for the new SaaS offer bundle. Per our call, we want to run a short preflight before we submit the final offer to the Azure Marketplace to avoid the common runtime/identity rejections. Attached is the runbook draft (redwood_publisher_runbook_v1.pdf) and a one-page checklist (offer-deploy-checklist.xlsx).

Brief asks for this week:
- ACME: provide tenant ID + a test service principal with Contributor (scoped to a test resource group) by EOD Tue Oct 7.
- Susan / Contoso: confirm your region selection is West US 2 so we can align SKU mapping.
- Marissa / Karthik (internal): please validate the API callbacks in the runbook — specifically the post-provision webhook and SSO claim mapping section.

I'll run the deployment smoke test once the SP is provisioned. If ACME can also upload the identity evidence bundle (acme-identity-evidence.zip) to the secure drive link or as a signed DocuSign packet, that will help speed validation.

Thanks,
Mateo
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_publisher_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF), offer-deploy-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: ACME Cloud Solutions <partners@acmecloud.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: offer deployment runbook + operator access coordination

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the runbook. We can provision a test SP by Monday (Oct 6). Tenant: 8f4b3c21-xxxx-4a6f-9c89-7b2adf0f5b8a. We'll scope it to a sandbox RG named acme-redwood-test.

Question: does Redwood require the SP to have Directory.Read.All to complete identity proofing, or will a Contributor-only role suffice for the deployment smoke test? We prefer least-privilege for the vendor SP.

Also attaching a short packet with our identity exports — we will upload the signed evidence to the DocuSign link once you confirm the expected format.

Cheers,
Luis Perez
Alliance Lead, ACME Cloud Solutions

Attachments: acme-identity-evidence.zip (manifest + cert stubs)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: partners@acmecloud.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: offer deployment runbook + operator access coordination

Luis — great, thanks for the tenant ID. For the smoke test we do not need Directory.Read.All; Contributor scoped to the RG is fine for provisioning + webhook verification. Directory permissions are required only for tenant-level claim validation when customers request SSO binding — we'll ask for explicit consent in that later step.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the webhook verification flow in section 3.2 of the runbook? Specifically:
- Expected 200 response within 5s for the post-provision callback
- Payload: {"tenantId": "{tenant}", "offerId": "{offer}"} and HMAC-SHA256 header x-rw-signature

Kimberly — FYI on the DocuSign packet; we might need the legal stamp for the co-sell acknowledgement.

I'll plan the smoke test for Tue Oct 7 10:00 PT. If ACME can share the SP credentials via the secure vault link 30 minutes prior we can kick off the run.

On Mon, Oct 6, 2025 at 07:58 AM ACME Cloud Solutions <partners@acmecloud.com> wrote:
> Attached the identity bundle. Let us know the final format for DocuSign.
>
> - Luis

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, partners@acmecloud.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: offer deployment runbook + operator access coordination

Thanks — I reviewed section 3.2. A couple clarity updates I recommend before the smoke test:

- Add an explicit retry policy for the webhook: 3 attempts, exponential backoff (1s, 3s, 9s). If all fail mark provisioning FAILED and surface error code 504 to the portal.
- Clarify that the HMAC key rotates daily for security; include the rotation API path (/internal/keys/rotate) so ACME's operator knows where to fetch the current key during testing.
- Confirm the payload schema to include an iso8601 timestamp and a correlation_id field.

I'll push a revision to the runbook PDF and re-attach. Also, for the DocuSign co-sell acknowledgement: Kimberly, can you confirm whether we need a separate co-sell addendum or if the standard publisher acknowledgement suffices?

Marissa
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_publisher_runbook_v1.pdf (updated)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, partners@acmecloud.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: offer deployment runbook + operator access coordination

All —

We can use the standard publisher acknowledgement for co-sell; no separate addendum required unless ACME requests custom resale terms. I'll prepare the DocuSign packet with the co-sell checkbox prefilled. Next steps:

- ACME: upload signed identity evidence to DocuSign link and share SP credentials to secure vault by Tue 10:00 PT.
- Redwood: Marissa will publish the runbook revision; Karthik will run the webhook smoke test and post results here.

If the smoke test passes we will proceed to the Azure portal offer submission on Wed Oct 8 and set the co-sell intake with the field team for Oct 15.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships Operations | Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
Attachment: offer-deploy-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
